resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says early 1930s. The May 1932 Forest Lookouts item says the Twin Mounds tower in district 10 was already completed, which fits. The item does not name the site beyond the Clark County heading, so the story says built by 1932 and keeps the Register's wording.

notes_for_editor: Four sources plus the Register. The 1932 item is the earliest date found; the Forest Lookouts page files it under Clark County but does not say the Twin Mounds entry is this tower, so treat 1932 as a 'by' date. The WJFW and Door County Pulse articles are statewide; neither names Twin Mound. Door County Pulse gives no year, so 2015 rests on WJFW and the Register. Nothing readable says whether the tower is open to visitors, has been sold, or has been rented since 2015; JSONline and AnyPlaceAmerica returned HTTP 403, and a Facebook group snippet about a retired tower in the Clark County Forest was unreadable and not used. The OpenStreetMap node gives 399 m against the Register's 398 m, which is not material and was not used. No photos added. Brief record: county, agency and registration agree with NHLR; the brief lists no built date, so one is added; no corrections. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the Door County Pulse page shows only a 'Department of Natural Resources' line beneath the article, not a credit, so the story no longer calls the notice reposted or credited to the DNR; the DNR decision and new-owner wording are kept as the article states them.
